---
name: Something in a skill is wrong
about: A command that fails, a schema that does not validate, advice that no longer matches the library
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Which skill**
Path to the `SKILL.md`, for example `05-mcp-protocol-and-tools/mcp-server-stdio-tool-schema`.

**What happened**
The command you ran or the snippet you copied, and what came back. Paste the error verbatim —
a paraphrased error is usually a different error.

**What the skill claims**
Quote the line that turned out to be wrong. Skills pin library versions on purpose, so if the
advice was correct for the pinned version and broke in a later one, say which version you are on.

**Environment**
OS, language runtime, and the version of the library the skill names.
